title: India's Digital Divide — Map 1: The Big Numbers
credit: Data: NFHS-6 · Boundaries: Government of India

metric.label: Women who have used the internet

beats.say: India just passed a billion internet users. But look closer — who's still missing?
Two-thirds of women are online now — sixty-four percent. The national average, at least. The map disagrees.
On this map, hotter means more women online. See the two Indias.

stops.say: Kerala, eighty-seven. The south is connected.
Uttarakhand, seventy-seven. The middle sits lower.
Tripura, under forty-nine. In the East, half the women have never been online.

beats.say: Same country, same year — a forty-five point spread. That's Map One.
